note: _cujus ventilabrum in manu sua_ – the fan is his hand. The word _cujus_ is not to be translated; it reflects Hebrew usage; see Ps 40:5 (Vg 39:5) and Hagen, pp. 67–68.
_tunc dimisit eum_ – then he (John) gave him permission (to be baptized); dann gab er (Johannes) ihm (Jesus) die Erlaubnis (getauft zu werden). – Hagen, p. 68.
